meta.name: owasp-security
meta.description: Comprehensive OWASP-aligned security guidance across six standards - Top 10 (2021) for web apps, ASVS 5.0, MASVS v2.1.0 for mobile, API Security Top 10 (2023), Kubernetes Top 10 (2022), and the Agentic Applications 2026 edition for AI/LLM. Use for security reviews, vulnerability audits, secure auth/crypto/access-control implementation, Kubernetes manifest hardening, and LLM/agent prompt-injection defense - including indirect requests like "is this login flow secure?", "review this endpoint", or "audit my pod spec".

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会按照OWASP的六个标准，对Web应用、API、移动应用、容器和AI/LLM系统进行安全审查、漏洞检测和修复建议。它会检查认证、加密、访问控制、注入、配置等问题。
howto.when: 当你请求安全审查、漏洞审计，或者说出“这个登录流程安全吗？”、“检查这个端点”、“审计我的pod规范”等指令时触发。

say.note: Claude将按照OWASP标准分析认证逻辑。

howto.what_en: Claude follows six OWASP standards to perform security reviews, vulnerability detection, and remediation advice for web apps, APIs, mobile apps, containers, and AI/LLM systems. It checks authentication, cryptography, access control, injection, misconfiguration, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request a security review, vulnerability audit, or say things like "Is this login flow secure?", "Review this endpoint", or "Audit my pod spec".

say_en.text: Check this login flow for security vulnerabilities
say_en.note: Claude will analyze authentication logic per OWASP.

say_en.text: Audit my Kubernetes pod config file
say_en.note: It will check container security settings.

say_en.text: Does this API endpoint have authorization issues?
